name: blitz-pet
description: A pen-drawn Blitzcrank desk pet for macOS that hooks any sentence on screen and explains it in context

scripts.build:native: for n in ocr ax-at; do swiftc -O -target arm64-apple-macos13 native/$n.swift -o native/$n-arm64 && swiftc -O -target x86_64-apple-macos13 native/$n.swift -o native/$n-x64 && lipo -create native/$n-arm64 native/$n-x64 -output native/$n && rm native/$n-arm64 native/$n-x64; done

build.copyright: Blitz Boy is an unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Riot Games.

extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Blitz Boy reads the text under your pointer.

author: Aeriths1
